newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine World Bank credits may be $3.5 bln by 1998.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine World Bank credits may be $3.5 bln by 1998.

text.p: Ukraine could receive up to $3.5 billion in World Bank credits over 1996-98, the government press service said on Tuesday.
The statement quoted Roman Shpek, chief of the National Agency of Ukraine for Reconstruction and Development, who spoke at a recent meeting of top government officials.
World Bank credits to Ukraine currently total $1.38 billion for seven projects, including coal sector restructuring, agricultural reform, and development of the energy sector.
